expectations.text: Distinguishes the asker's own reporting duties (if in scope) from data requests cascading down the value chain
expectations.evidence: "What you must produce depends on whether you are in scope of CSRD yourself"; separate sections for in-scope duties vs customer/value-chain requests

expectations.text: Applies the value-chain cap: requests to ≤1,000-employee partners are capped at the voluntary standard's (Reg. 2026/1560) content
expectations.evidence: States the cap but misidentifies the instrument as non-law: "VSME, endorsed in a Commission Recommendation in July 2025"; no Reg (EU) 2026/1560

expectations.text: Covers Scope 3 reporting expectations under the revised ESRS for in-scope reporters (GHG categories, estimation/proxies where primary data is unavailable)
expectations.evidence: "Scope 3 has 15 categories... Only categories that are material need to be disclosed under ESRS"; "estimates and sector averages where primary data is unavailable"

expectations.text: Advises practical responses: voluntary-standard-aligned data package, estimation methodologies, phased supplier engagement
expectations.evidence: "Standardise using VSME. Offer it as the default response"; "Use spend-based factors first, then move to activity data"; "Request data from your own suppliers proportionately, prioritising hotspots"

expectations.text: Mentions transition reliefs/phase-ins where relevant rather than asserting maximal obligations
expectations.evidence: "phase-ins and estimation help"; materiality-limited disclosure rather than maximal obligations; cap shields small partners
